records.title: Penumbra successor path evaluation
records.decision_rule: Preregister workload and platform thresholds before collection; require parity, material advantage, no lower-tier or native-backend regression, and acceptable maintenance.

records.title: Native backend entry and common-RHI parity
records.decision_rule: Metal first after stable contracts; Vulkan and D3D12 only after Metal differential, recovery, benchmark, divergence, staffing, and maintenance gates.

records.title: Meridian UI display-list renderer selection
records.decision_rule: Choose from correctness, accessibility, text quality, latency, memory, platform support, recovery, maintenance, and license evidence.

records.title: Cairn solver and determinism portfolio
records.decision_rule: Require provenance and differential corpus before migration; define measured determinism envelopes.

records.title: Isobar atmosphere and weather algorithms
records.decision_rule: Select per tier from visual, stability, determinism, cost, authorability, fallback, and coupling evidence.

records.title: Basalt geometry and terrain hierarchy
records.decision_rule: Select conventional LOD, meshlet, sparse, or hierarchy approaches by measured precision, streaming, deformation, memory, and maintenance.

records.title: Torsant specialized solver portfolio
records.decision_rule: Choose specialized optional solvers per effect/tier; no universal solver and no hidden disabled cost.

records.title: Alluvium evaluator representation and execution portfolio
records.decision_rule: Require a strict reference path; select scalar, SIMD, GPU, tiled, sparse, or worker kernels by structural correctness, determinism, latency, throughput, transfer, memory, recovery, platform coverage, debugging, and maintenance evidence.

records.title: Alluvium dependency replacement and deep kernel ownership
records.decision_rule: Keep permissive foundations by default; replacement requires preregistered material product benefit, representative evidence, provenance and license review, migration cost, maintainable ownership, and an ADR.

records.title: Release cryptography and key-management selection
records.decision_rule: Threat model, platform key storage, recovery, rotation, reproducibility, auditability, license, and maintenance decide.
